slides.say: Which values must go in an Effect’s dependency list? The reactive ones.
Server URL is outside the component. It never changes on a re-render, so it is not a dependency. Room id is a prop. It can change, so it is.

slides.text: Props, state and every variable in the component body are reactive.
slides.say: Props, state, and every value calculated in the component body are reactive. They can change on a re-render.
Move server URL inside, computed during render, and it becomes reactive too. Now it must be listed.
